helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.description: Quick answers to common questions about how AlgoMinds works.

thinkFirst.question: What does "Think-First" mean?
thinkFirst.answer: Before you can write code, you explain your strategy to the AI interviewer in the chat panel. Once your strategy is approved, the code editor unlocks for Phase 2.

credits.question: What are credits and how do I earn more?
credits.answer: Credits let you request extra AI feedback during a session. You earn more by solving problems, keeping your daily streak, and completing quests.

quest.question: What is Quest (Bug Whacker)?
quest.answer: Quest is a timed mini-game where you spot the buggy line in a code snippet before time runs out. Check the Quest tab for leaderboards and badges.

contests.question: How do contests work?
contests.answer: Contests are timed events with a set of problems chosen by difficulty. Submit your solutions before the contest ends to appear on the leaderboard.

peerInterview.question: What is Peer Interview?
peerInterview.answer: Peer Interview pairs you with another user to practice a mock interview together — one of you plays interviewer, the other candidate.
